name: Backlight
description: A soft coloured glow behind an image or a card. It takes its colours from a list you give, or from a blurred, enlarged copy of the content itself.

children.description: The image or card the glow sits behind.

colors.description: Glow colours, any CSS colours. Leave out to use a blurred copy of the children instead.

intensity.description: How strong the glow is, from 0 to 1.

blur.description: Blur radius of the glow in pixels.

scale.description: How much larger than the content the glow is.

duration.description: Seconds for one slow cycle of the glow.

isStill.description: Keeps the glow still instead of slowly moving.

requirements: The glow is decoration: aria-hidden, pointer-events none, and it never takes focus
In copy mode the copy is inert as well as hidden, so it adds no focus stops and no duplicate content for assistive technology
The content on top is unchanged and keeps its own contrast; the glow never sits in front of text
The slow movement can be stopped with isStill or the rdm-still class, and stops for visitors who ask for less motion (prefers-reduced-motion)
In forced-colors (high contrast) mode the glow is removed
Does not flash: the glow changes slowly, never more than three times in a second (WCAG 2.3.1)
screenReader: The glow is not announced; the content is read as normal

use_when: Giving a product screenshot or a card some depth
A hero image that should feel lit from behind
avoid_when: Content with ids or form fields in copy mode, where the copy repeats them (give colors instead)
Dense layouts where the glow would colour the text next to it
anti_patterns: A very high intensity that lowers the contrast of nearby text
Using copy mode on a large video
